items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I worked for Ralph Capone at a place -- at the Sunset -- it was owned by Ralph Capone. ... Yes, I saw Ralph. ... Ralph Capone I saw many times.

ctx.x: You could sit in your house any night in Chicago and hear a huge explosion down the block -- some tailor shop that didn't pay off for protection or a grocery store -- they bombed them. As a matter of fact, I worked for Ralph Capone at a place -- at the Sunset -- it was owned by Ralph Capone.
Did you ever see him or meet him?
